summary: Hosted API: client receives malformed SSE events after retry; SDK parser breaks
description:
Deployment mode: Hosted API.

Issue summary:
Customer using OpenAI-compatible endpoint reports their client occasionally fails with JSON parse errors mid-stream. They observe it mostly when their HTTP client retries a dropped connection. Packet capture suggests the retry response starts streaming but contains an extra 'data:' line with partial JSON.

Impact:
- Customer streaming session fails; they fall back to non-streaming and see increased latency
- Not an outage, but production-impacting for their chat feature

Repro notes:
- Happens when client retries within ~1s of a disconnect
- More frequent on long prompts (first token > 2s)
comments: 2026-02-18 13:55 UTC (Jordan Blake): Requesting a raw trace. Customer provided sanitized HTTP transcript.
2026-02-18 18:10 UTC (Soojin Lee): Identified gateway bug: on upstream reconnect, we were double-writing the SSE preamble and could emit a truncated event.
2026-02-19 00:40 UTC (Soojin Lee): Patch in redwood-openai-compat PR 219; adds guard to ensure SSE event boundaries preserved on retry.
2026-02-20 09:30 UTC (Jordan Blake): Customer tested patched edge in staging endpoint; no parse errors after 200 retries.
2026-02-21 16:05 UTC (Soojin Lee): Deployed to prod us-west then global. Monitoring indicates drop in 'sdk_stream_parse_error' metric.
resolution: Fixed SSE retry handling to prevent truncated/malformed events after reconnect. Deployed gateway compatibility patch and validated with customer retry harness.
workaround: Until rollout complete: disable automatic retries on streaming requests or retry with a fresh request (new connection) only after backoff >= 2s.
root_cause: SSE framing bug during upstream reconnect caused partial JSON to be emitted as a standalone data line, breaking strict SDK parsers.
follow_ups: Add fuzz test for SSE framing under disconnect/retry
Document recommended retry behavior for streaming
Add gateway metric for 'double preamble' detection
